description: Pundits are screaming about the so-called “AI bubble.” But historically slow-to-adopt industries like medicine and law are actually embracing AI at an unprecedented speed. Sarah Guo and Elad Gil look ahead to 2026, breaking down the major trends that will define the next era of AI technologies. They explore the future of AI foundational models, predicting breakthroughs in solving complex scientific problems. They share competing views on the timeline for robotics and self-driving cars, debating…
classificationReason: The episode explicitly devotes multiple chapters to robotics, self-driving cars, startup competition, and related AI research.
qualityReason: Named expert hosts, structured chapters, and a developed forecasting discussion indicate substantive analysis.
